title: Equations for the two canonical mixed comparison routes
statement: Fix the purity setting of [def-pur-conventions], the actual stage comparisons of [def-pur-kappa-coefficient-stage-comparisons], and the canonical square maps of [def-pur-kappa-geometric-compositors]. For $E\hookrightarrow L$ finite over $\mathbf Q_\ell$ and $u_0:T'_0\to T_0$ between separated finite-type $k_0$-schemes, write $U=Lu^*$ and let $C$ be the actual integral scalar extension or its rational localization. With the specified comparisons $j_U,j_H,j_G,c_H,c_G$, define the mixed equation at $N$ to be $G'(j_{U,N})j_{G,UN}C(c_{G,N})C(U\kappa_N)=\kappa'_{U'CN}c'_{H,CN}U'(j_{H,N})j_{U,HN}$. Each side is an explicit composite with the same endpoints. Define coefficient unit and successive-extension laws using the actual scalar unitor and multiplication associator, comparing two changes with the single composite change. For finite quotients use the actual quotient ring maps and the scalar-extension identity and composition isomorphisms. Integral formulas are on bounded constructible finite-Tor objects; rational formulas use the actual bounded constructible category. These predicates abbreviate those composite equalities and have no arbitrary maps as parameters.
